title: Hyperdimensional computing benchmark, Raspberry Pi vs GPU
highlights: MNIST: 70,000 images (60k train, 10k test), 28x28 flattened to 784 inputs, with torchhd and hard quantization.
Pi 4B at D=5000 on a single thread, against a Colab Tesla T4 at D=10000.
Compared training time, test time, memory and accuracy.
summary: Hyperdimensional computing on MNIST, benchmarked on a Raspberry Pi 4B against a Colab Tesla T4. The GPU was faster and more accurate; the Pi is a practical cheap offline option.
